seo.title: Order Collection — Potli Hammersmith
seo.description: Order Potli online for collection from King Street, Hammersmith. Pay at pickup — no card needed.
seo.ogDescription: Order online, pay at pickup. Indian street food from King Street.

heading: Order Collection
intro: Order online, pay at pickup. Choose your dishes, pick a time, done.
payNote: Pay at pickup — cash or card at the counter.
menuHint: Tick everything you'd like. Quantities and any changes can be noted in the box at the bottom.
noticeNote: Dishes marked with an advance-notice badge need ordering that far ahead — pick a later collection date for those.

afterSubmit.heading: Order Confirmed!
afterSubmit.body: Your order is with the kitchen. We'll call you back to confirm the total and the pickup time.
